properties.description:
record_alias puts the domain nouns a user actually uses onto the node they mean, on the five types that name a thing rather than a statement. Terms MERGE, so a second word never costs the first and repeating one is a no-op; the node's `name` is untouched and nothing keys on an alias, so a wrong one cannot make anything else wrong.

The merge is the load-bearing part rather than a convenience. A replacing setter here would be this codebase's most-repeated defect — a write path that builds a node from a partial property set and erases what the caller did not name, fixed four times already — arriving in the one place where the value erased is a person's own vocabulary.
properties.name: The design holds the user's own vocabulary for its parts, additively
